props.name: id
props.description: Native id — falls back to FormItem field id when nested

props.name: name
props.description: Native name — falls back to FormItem `prop` when nested

props.name: modelValue
props.description: v-model — scalar for single mode, array for `multiple`

props.name: options
props.description: Option list rendered in the dropdown

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show clear control when a value is present

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-select mode — `modelValue` becomes `(string | number)[]`. Dropdown stays open after each pick; selected values render as tags.

props.name: collapseTags
props.description: Collapse excess tags to `+N` (multiple mode only).

props.name: maxCollapseTags
props.description: Max visible tags before collapse when `collapseTags` is true.

props.name: virtual
props.description: Enable virtual scrolling in the dropdown. When `undefined`, auto-enables when option count exceeds `virtualThreshold`. Set `false` to force full DOM render.

props.name: virtualThreshold
props.description: Option count threshold for auto virtual scroll.

props.name: filterDebounce
props.description: Delay local and remote filtering to avoid repeated large-list work. @default 200

props.name: remote
props.description: Remote search — skips local filtering; call `remoteMethod` on filter input. Implies filterable search input when open.

props.name: remoteMethod
props.type: ( query: string, context: SelectRemoteContext, ) => void | SelectOption[] | Promise<void | SelectOption[]>
props.description: Invoked with the current filter query when `remote` is true. Returning options enables built-in latest-request-wins handling; returning void remains compatible with externally controlled `options`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading indicator while remote options are fetched

events.name: remove-tag
events.description: Fired when a tag is removed in multiple mode

events.name: remote-error
events.description: Fired for a non-abort remote lookup failure.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Trailing auxiliary content beside the control

slots.name: option
slots.description: Custom option row in the dropdown

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Empty state when no options match

slots.name: loading
slots.description: Loading indicator while remote options load
